content.short: European neobank with multi-currency cards and business accounts.
content.description: bunq, founded in 2012 in Amsterdam, is one of Europe's largest neobanks, holding a full European banking licence and serving both consumers and businesses across the region. Its all-in-one app lets users open multi-currency accounts and sub-accounts, spend with physical and virtual cards, budget and save with automated tools, and invest in stocks and crypto alongside everyday banking. bunq offers free local IBANs in multiple countries, low-cost foreign exchange, and travel features such as in-app eSIMs. Built mobile-first for people who live and work internationally, bunq blends personal finance, business banking, and cross-border payments into a single flexible platform.
content.meta: bunq is a European neobank with multi-currency accounts, cards, and investing. Discover bunq and other Neobanks on Lancers Web3 Explorer.
